rules: UNIT CONVENTION: x and y are dimensionless multipliers on the metro median $/sqft, condition-only, same micro-location and prototype size (1,500 sqft): entry price/sqft = x * median $/sqft; post-renovation ARV/sqft = y * median $/sqft. Composition bias (flipped stock is smaller, median build year 1978 - oldest ATTOM has recorded - and in below-median neighborhoods) is EXCLUDED from x by construction: do not also apply a neighborhood/age haircut or you double-count. DEFAULTS (mid-2026 market): x_cosmetic 0.92, x_moderate 0.83, x_gut 0.70; y_cosmetic 1.02, y_moderate 1.04, y_gut 1.08. DERIVATION: (a) x anchors - Zillow hedonically-controlled fixer discount (vs SIMILAR homes, i.e. condition-only, exactly our definition): 'needs work/TLC' ~-8%, marketed fixer-uppers -7.3% (Feb 2025) widening to -14% (Jul 2026, steepest recorded); cosmetic sits at the light end (-8%, x=0.92), moderate at the deep half of listed fixers (-17%, x=0.83). Gut stock trades off-MLS/unfinanceable: academic distressed lit brackets it - Campbell/Giglio/Pathak (AER 2011) raw foreclosure discount ~27% vs Clauretie/Daneshvary (2009) 7.5-7.9% residual after condition controls, implying condition+marketability ~19-25 pts; x_gut=0.70 (-30%) sits at the conservative-deep end AND independently reproduces JBREC/Kiavi surveyed flipper purchase of 64-66% of ARV (x_gut/y_gut=0.648). ATTOM cross-check: raw flip purchase $260k vs ~$400k US median (ratio 0.65) minus composition (small-home $/sqft premium, 1978 stock, cheaper tracts) leaves ~15-22% condition-only for the modal flip - consistent with x_moderate. (b) y anchors - Zillow controlled remodeled premium +3.7% (2025), +2.2% (2026): y_cosmetic 1.02, y_moderate 1.04 at/just above its range; y_gut 1.08 capped below the new-construction premium (record-low 7.8% Q2-2025; new builds actually CHEAPER per sqft than existing, $218.66 vs $226.56), because appraisal comps and neighborhood ceilings bind hardest at gut scope. CONSISTENCY IDENTITY (deliberately conservative): implied gross flip ROI (y-x)/x = 10.9% cosmetic / 25.3% moderate / 54.3% gut; moderate (ATTOM's modal flip) lands at or below every recent ATTOM national print (25.4% Q1-2026, 25.5% FY2025, 29.6% FY2024 - note the market has deteriorated below the 29-30% figure in the task brief; we calibrated to the tougher current prints); flip-mix-weighted (55/35/10) = 20.3%, well below observed. Gut exceeding the ATTOM median is correct, not an error: gut deals are the deep-discount tail acquired at 64-66% of ARV per JBREC, and the wide gross spread must fund $60-110/sqft of hard cost - ATTOM/Backflip Q1-2026 shows net flip profit after renovation/holding/transaction costs is only ~$15.2k (5.8%), so gross spread conservatism, not gross spread size, is the binding check. TIGHTNESS RULE: see table_json.tightness_rule - x-only, additive, bounded [-0.02,+0.05], with a hard clamp that implied moderate ROI never exceeds latest ATTOM national gross ROI + 500bps. ENGINE USE: for BRRRR, ARV for the 75% refi = y_scope * median $/sqft * 1500; forced equity vs the $25k floor = (y-x) * median $/sqft * 1500 - renovation cost. When a metro's median $/sqft makes moderate-scope forced equity negative at defaults, the deal fails regardless of rent - that is the intended conservative behavior.
notes: (1) This task's table_json is intentionally {defaults, bands, tightness_rule(+consistency_check)}, not a 51-state map - these are national market-calibration constants per the task spec; state/metro variation enters only through the bounded tightness rule and the metro median $/sqft the multipliers scale. (2) Freshness: task brief cited ATTOM ~29-30% (2024-25); live data through Q1 2026 shows 25.4-25.5% (FY2025 lowest since 2008), so constants were tightened to the current prints - stricter than the brief required. Zillow's fixer discount doubled to 14% between Feb 2025 and Jul 2026; defaults reflect the current (soft) national market, which is why the baseline tightness band (MoS 3.0-4.5) carries zero adjustment. (3) Key bias warning encoded in the convention: Zillow figures are condition-only (vs similar homes) and can be used directly; ATTOM raw purchase-vs-median ratios CANNOT (composition: smaller/older/cheaper-tract stock) - they were used only as a bracket after decomposition. (4) All figures from public/press sources only (Zillow research releases via media syndication, ATTOM press summaries, NBER/AER and Real Estate Economics abstracts, JBREC survey highlights via Kiavi) - no licensed data. Several primary URLs (zillow.mediaroom.com, attomdata.com, prnewswire.com, cnn.com) returned 403 to automated fetch; figures were corroborated across at least two independent syndications each via search. (5) Uncertainty bands are calibration ranges for sensitivity analysis, not confidence intervals; the widest relative uncertainty is x_gut/y_gut (off-market pricing is thinly documented publicly) - the engine's flip-mode outputs for gut scope should be labeled lower-confidence in the UI. (6) Downstream tasks: if the Phase-2 engine also applies a distress/motivated-seller assumption, do not stack it on x - the gut anchor already embeds the marketability component per the C&D decomposition.

table.tightness_rule: Adjust x ONLY (entry discount is the cyclical margin; y gets NO adjustment - insufficient evidence: Zillow's controlled remodeled premium moved just 0.8%->3.7%->2.2% across a full cycle, within band noise). Tightness metric: metro months-of-supply (MoS) from public Realtor.com/Redfin series. Additive adjustment to all three x values: MoS<=2.0 (tight): +0.05; 2.0<MoS<=3.0: +0.025; 3.0<MoS<=4.5 (national baseline, defaults already reflect mid-2026 conditions): 0; 4.5<MoS<=6.0 (soft): -0.01; MoS>6.0: -0.02. Hard bounds [-0.02, +0.05]. Post-adjustment clamp: implied moderate-scope gross flip ROI (y_moderate - x_adj)/x_adj must not exceed latest ATTOM national median gross flip ROI + 500bps metro-dispersion allowance (currently 25.4% + 5.0% = 30.4%); if exceeded, raise x_adj to equality. Justification of magnitude: Zillow's hedonically-controlled fixer discount swung ~10-11 pts across the last cycle (~3-4% in the 2022 frenzy -> 7.3% Feb-2025 -> 14% Jul-2026, steepest recorded); total rule swing of 7 pts is inside that observed range, and asymmetric on purpose - full effect when tightness hurts the deal (entry discount compresses), half credit when it helps (soft-market discounts are partly offset by weaker exits, which we hold flat).

consistency_check.verdict: moderate 25.3% <= 25.4% (Q1-2026) <= 29.6% (FY2024); mix-weighted 20.3% well below all prints; gut x/y = 0.648 independently matches JBREC/Kiavi surveyed flipper purchase at 64-66% of ARV
